definitions.explanation: How a person was raised, and the manners and behavior that result from their upbringing. Often used to comment on whether someone shows signs of a good or poor upbringing.
The way something (a person, plant, or animal) has grown or developed. Often used in compounds with a place name to indicate where someone grew up.

examples.japanese: {育|そだ}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: You can sense a good upbringing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧{育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that you can tell someone's upbringing from the way they eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{育|そだ}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I was born in Osaka, but I grew up in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{育|そだ}ちな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}さない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: She grew up in Tokyo, so she doesn't speak dialect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the good weather this year, the vegetables are growing well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{育|そだ}ち⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{慣|な}れている→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: I was both born and raised in Hokkaido, so I've been used to snow since childhood.

notes:
USAGE:
The set phrase ⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{育|そだ}ち⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (both born and raised in) is extremely common in self-introductions. When commenting on upbringing quality, {育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ is a common but potentially judgmental expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い (well-bred, well-raised)
- {育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poorly raised)
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{育|そだ}ち (raised in Tokyo)
- ⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{育|そだ}ち⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (both born and raised in)
- {育|そだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (growing well — for plants)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育|そだ}て→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: child-rearing, raising (active — the parent's perspective)
- ⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: origin, where one is from (more neutral/factual)
